entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My butler demurred, smiling."
entries.dialogueText: My butler demurred, smiling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Golden candlesticks stood along the..."
entries.dialogueText: Golden candlesticks stood along the length of the table in the royal dining room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother hurried into the room, ho..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother hurried into the room, holding the train of her silk brocade gown. Pabel calmly pulled out her chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their flickering light cast a warm..."
entries.dialogueText: Their flickering light cast a warm glow on my daughter's face -- a stark contrast to the coldness in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their flickering light cast a warm..."
entries.dialogueText: Their flickering light cast a warm glow on my daughter's face, matching the warmth in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Truly sorry, dears. It took two la..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry, dears. It took two ladies-in-waiting to squeeze me into this old thing."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But I wouldn't miss supper for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I wouldn't miss supper for the world. It's been ages since the three of us sat around the same table."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even among the myriad demands of w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even among the myriad demands of war, a king must make time for his family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, even among the many pressures..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, even among the many pressures of ruling, a king must make time for his family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The four of us. Isn't that right,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The four of us. Isn't that right, Pabel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come off it, Mother. You must know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come off it, Mother. You must know that Vina can hardly stand me these days. But we Torases have appearances to keep up."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My butler demurred, his face a mask..."
entries.dialogueText: My butler demurred, his face a mask of civility.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm only here to serve, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm only here to serve, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You honor me, Your Majesty. But I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You honor me, Your Majesty. But I'm only here to serve."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother took a long glance at Vin..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother took a long glance at Vina. She spoke up cheerfully.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's been highly in demand since..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's been highly in demand since her stint in Pales. I'm lucky if I can get an audience with her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's been a hard year for Vina. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been a hard year for Vina. I wanted to give her time to process her feelings."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's very kind of you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""How very kind of you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "How very kind of you, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You scared him off. I don't know w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You scared him off. I don't know what you threatened him with, but it must have been terrible."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He wasn't plotting anything. You h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wasn't plotting anything. You had him framed."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He wasn't plotting anything. You h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wasn't plotting anything. You had a hand in his disappearance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Vina smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina smiled in spite of herself."
entries.dialogueText: Vina smiled in spite of herself.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Nothing that a little liquid refre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing that a little liquid refreshment can't cure."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You sent him to Pales. You knew he..."
entries.dialogueText: "You sent him to Pales. You knew he would die, and you sent him anyway."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter managed a weak smile."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter managed a weak smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter's jaw stiffened."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter's jaw stiffened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel rang a small bell. An army of..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel rang a small bell. An army of kitchen staff materialized around the table, bearing plates of food.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He fastidiously wiped the dust off..."
entries.dialogueText: He fastidiously wiped the dust off an ancient-looking wine bottle before pouring glasses for Vina and my mother, then me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He fastidiously wiped the dust off..."
entries.dialogueText: He fastidiously wiped the dust off an ancient-looking wine bottle before pouring glasses for Vina and my mother. I received my usual non-alcoholic substitute.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""A rare Cantuavo Grand Cru. Bottled..."
entries.dialogueText: "A rare Cantuavo Grand Cru. Bottled in 1926, days prior to the uprising."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I bet it's aged more gracefully th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I bet it's aged more gracefully than I have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A curious choice, Pabel.""
entries.dialogueText: "A curious choice, Pabel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reminder of triumph over our sed..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reminder of triumph over our seditious internal elements. Well chosen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take it away. I can't stand to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take it away. I can't stand to be reminded of that time."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""There aren't many new wines coming..."
entries.dialogueText: "There aren't many new wines coming out of the vineyard these days. Soil damage from the gold mines, if I recall correctly."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I've had no choice but to go back..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've had no choice but to go back through the old vintages. I do hope you enjoy this one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others laughed politely."
entries.dialogueText: The others laughed politely.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Heavy is the head that wears the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heavy is the head that wears the crown, but even heavier are the under-eye bags."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm so sorry, Your Majesty. I'll h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm so sorry, Your Majesty. I'll have another brought at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured to the staff, who quick..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured to the staff, who quickly removed our wine glasses and replaced them with new ones.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The same goes for princesses.""
entries.dialogueText: "The same goes for princesses."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What a privilege, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "What a privilege, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Pardon my interruption, but dinner..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pardon my interruption, but dinner is served."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""My stint as a near-hostage, you me..."
entries.dialogueText: "My stint as a near-hostage, you mean. A pity nothing came of it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It was an exhilarating assignment.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was an exhilarating assignment."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""An exceptional vintage for a speci..."
entries.dialogueText: "An exceptional vintage for a special occasion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel bowed and disappeared back in..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel bowed and disappeared back into the kitchen.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""This one's called Dandelion. A gif..."
entries.dialogueText: "This one's called Dandelion. A gift from our trade partners in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""From our store of Romus the Red. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "From our store of Romus the Red. I recall Her Highness was quite fond of that one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked down at my plate. Dinner t..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked down at my plate. Dinner tonight was Monqiz lobster with rice and plenty of butter.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Remind me. Do the crustaceans in M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remind me. Do the crustaceans in Monqiz now belong to Rumburg as well?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Your father couldn't stand lobster..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father couldn't stand lobster as a child, Vina. I could only get him to eat it by telling him it was a magical creature called a sea pheasant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. There's no such thing as a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. There's no such thing as a sea pheasant?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not true, Vina. Mother, sto..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not true, Vina. Mother, stop telling lies about the King."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They must. This one precisely rese..."
entries.dialogueText: "They must. This one precisely resembles Queen Beatrice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Keep up your wisecracks and this w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep up your wisecracks and this will be a very short dinner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did what I had to, Mother. Histo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did what I had to, Mother. History will vindicate me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An example of how we all believe w..."
entries.dialogueText: "An example of how we all believe what we want to, no matter how implausible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not disparage our Rumburgian al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not disparage our Rumburgian allies. They're giving us sorely needed aid."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother snickered. Vina didn't re..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother snickered. Vina didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother looked down at her plate...."
entries.dialogueText: My mother looked down at her plate. Vina didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother gave me an abashed look...."
entries.dialogueText: My mother gave me an abashed look. Vina didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother mouthed an apology. Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother mouthed an apology. Vina didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother nodded in agreement. Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother nodded in agreement. Vina didn't respond.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, Vina? Are you enjoying your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Vina? Are you enjoying your dinner?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina. This is a family dinner and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina. This is a family dinner and you will participate in family conversations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's on your mind, Vina? You kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's on your mind, Vina? You know you can tell me anything."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina picked at her food, still preo..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina picked at her food, still preoccupied.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sorry, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I had a long conversation with Man..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had a long conversation with Manus the other day."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The topic of marriage came up.""
entries.dialogueText: "The topic of marriage came up."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What? How dare he discuss marriage..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? How dare he discuss marriage without first asking the King for your hand?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that so? How lovely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? How lovely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The topic came up? Is he too cowar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The topic came up? Is he too cowardly to propose to you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aha. I knew you'd come running to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aha. I knew you'd come running to me about this sooner or later."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She slowly put down her fork."
entries.dialogueText: She slowly put down her fork.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Nothing. Or, well...""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing. Or, well..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father! What century is this?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Father! What century is this?!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Our relationship is more egalitari..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relationship is more egalitarian than that, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: She breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Lovely indeed! So does that mean w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lovely indeed! So does that mean we can go through with it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me warily."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me warily.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And? What are your thoughts?""
entries.dialogueText: "And? What are your thoughts?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I will ask you now. Do we have you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will ask you now. Do we have your permission to marry?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before I agree, there is another m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I agree, there is another marriage opportunity that we must discuss."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What? To whom?""
entries.dialogueText: "What? To whom?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Ricardus Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Ricardus Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Axel Reinhart.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Axel Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't be happier with your de..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't be happier with your decision. Let us begin planning the wedding at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, I promised you long ago that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, I promised you long ago that I would not influence your marriage. I shall keep that promise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina pushed away her plate with a s..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina pushed away her plate with a stunned expression.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, honey. Don't look so surprised.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, honey. Don't look so surprised."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina pushed away her plate with a s..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina pushed away her plate with a stunned look on her face. My mother frowned.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus, darling, are you quite sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, darling, are you quite sure about this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House Toras must hold the throne f..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras must hold the throne for a thousand years, as the Lord Himself ordained."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The future of our lineage is at st..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future of our lineage is at stake. If Vina does not marry a fellow Toras, I fear a coup from within our house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We cannot dilute the blood of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot dilute the blood of our house any further. This is the only way to consolidate power within the family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ricardus and the patriots of Su Om..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ricardus and the patriots of Su Omina have been good allies to us. They should be rewarded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I saw the way you looked at him at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I saw the way you looked at him at the gas deal signing. You like him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose you have objections?""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose you have objections?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina Toras, Queen of Rizia and Gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina Toras, Queen of Rizia and Grand Duchess of Pales. Doesn't that have a nice ring to it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would be foolish to refuse the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be foolish to refuse the benefits this union will bring to our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina reddened."
entries.dialogueText: Vina reddened.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, I think he's handsome. Everyo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I think he's handsome. Everyone does."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And he's much kinder than the medi..."
entries.dialogueText: "And he's much kinder than the media makes him out to be."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We discussed it. And I agreed to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "We discussed it. And I agreed to broach the subject with you before we went any further."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Rewarded?! After what happened in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rewarded?! After what happened in Iza?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's eyes widened."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's eyes widened.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Marry my cousin, or get usurped? T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Marry my cousin, or get usurped? Those are my choices?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And incestuous relations are part..."
entries.dialogueText: "And incestuous relations are part of His plan?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That is all I ever asked! Thank yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is all I ever asked! Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I suppose you have absolutely..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I suppose you have absolutely no interest in knowing that the Duke of Pales has asked for your hand in marriage."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Perhaps that's the way things work..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps that's the way things worked in the past. Today, other nations will see us as inbred lunatics."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked helplessly at her grandm..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked helplessly at her grandmother. Estela had a frozen expression on her face.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina frowned. She seemed to be weig..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina frowned. She seemed to be weighing the title in her mind.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll admit I enjoyed getting to kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll admit I enjoyed getting to know Axel. He's much kinder than the media makes him out to be."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He's handsome, to be sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "He's handsome, to be sure."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Benefits that you and Mr. Reinhart..."
entries.dialogueText: "Benefits that you and Mr. Reinhart have discussed without my involvement, I assume?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""First off, I object to you and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "First off, I object to you and the Duke of Pales discussing this without my involvement. As to the marriage itself..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She slowly and deliberately put dow..."
entries.dialogueText: She slowly and deliberately put down her fork.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can't bear it anymore. Father, d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't bear it anymore. Father, did you do it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother went pale. She shot Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother went pale. She shot Vina a look of warning.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Honey, please. Not at the dinner t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honey, please. Not at the dinner table."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it that you think I did?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it that you think I did?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree. Let us move on to a more..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Let us move on to a more pleasant topic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's quite all right. Yes, I was t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's quite all right. Yes, I was the one who passed gas just now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please go on, Vina. You can ask me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please go on, Vina. You can ask me anything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter stared at me with hollo..."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter stared at me with hollow eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was in the middle of working wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was in the middle of working with Manus. Why would I want to dispose of him?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Rewarded?! For what?""
entries.dialogueText: "Rewarded?! For what?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Now, Vina. Don't forget that your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Vina. Don't forget that your venerable great-grandmother married within the family as well."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You sent him to Pales to keep him..."
entries.dialogueText: "You sent him to Pales to keep him away from me. He's no soldier. He could die at any time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were blinded by the hearts in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were blinded by the hearts in your eyes. House Sazon was using you all along."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The wound is still fresh. So I wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The wound is still fresh. So I will forgive your rash outburst, but not your slanderous accusation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, you have to understand. Manu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, you have to understand. Manus wasn't safe in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't know! But it's no coincide..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know! But it's no coincidence you brought Duchess Angelica back right after he left."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You never liked Manus. It was all..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never liked Manus. It was all a ruse."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You never liked Manus. You made th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never liked Manus. You made that obvious enough."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't know! One of your capricio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know! One of your capricious whims, maybe?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He's not bloody safe now, is he?!""
entries.dialogueText: "He's not bloody safe now, is he?!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And why would that be? Because of..."
entries.dialogueText: "And why would that be? Because of this bloody family!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You're wrong. I knew him. What we..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're wrong. I knew him. What we had together... that was real."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Don't bloody patronize me! I know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't bloody patronize me! I know what you are!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sweetheart... I know you're sad. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sweetheart... I know you're sad. But that's no reason to take it out on me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina seemed close to tears. My butl..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina seemed close to tears. My butler discreetly offered her a kerchief.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This is what you do to people you..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is what you do to people you hate, isn't it? Why, I wouldn't be surprised if you're the reason Mother... Mother..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She started sobbing. Estela rushed..."
entries.dialogueText: She started sobbing. Estela rushed over to her side of the table and embraced her tightly.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""There, there, darling. Let it all..."
entries.dialogueText: "There, there, darling. Let it all out."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Did you ever really want me on the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you ever really want me on the council? Or was that just to keep me busy while you... you..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No. Thanks, Pabel, but I'm fine.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Thanks, Pabel, but I'm fine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned back towards me."
entries.dialogueText: She turned back towards me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It seems like the end of the world..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems like the end of the world now, I know. But you've got your entire life ahead of you."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Slanderous! How can you sit there..."
entries.dialogueText: "Slanderous! How can you sit there calmly and say that?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This is why you didn't want me on..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is why you didn't want me on the council, isn't it? To keep me out of the way while you... you..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You'll fall in love again. And you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll fall in love again. And you'll look back on your present self and laugh at what a silly little girl she was, getting so hung up over someone she barely even knew."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina took a long, shaky breath."
entries.dialogueText: Vina took a long, shaky breath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know how much Manus meant to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how much Manus meant to you. I would never do anything to hurt him."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If this is what your father thinks..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this is what your father thinks is best for the kingdom, I suggest you go along with it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You... you're taking Father's side?""
entries.dialogueText: "You... you're taking Father's side?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your grandmother's right, Vina. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother's right, Vina. Your heartache will pass."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus may be gone, but you and I c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus may be gone, but you and I can still finish what he started."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish I could give you more time..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could give you more time to heal your broken heart. But your kingdom needs you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm afraid so. After all, I'm the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid so. After all, I'm the reason this particular branch of the Toras family nearly got chopped off the tree."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her gaze grew tender."
entries.dialogueText: Her gaze grew tender.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I wish it weren't up to you to sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish it weren't up to you to shore up our roots. But we women must do what needs to be done to protect the line of succession."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What's the point?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's the point?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know. Forgive my outburst.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. Forgive my outburst."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know. I'm sorry for my outburst.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. I'm sorry for my outburst."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes... I'd like that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... I'd like that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't need my kingdom.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need my kingdom."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I understand. But it still hurts.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. But it still hurts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, there's something I need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, there's something I need to bring up with you."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Wait. Let me speak first.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Let me speak first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know how fond I am of Manus. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how fond I am of Manus. But I have an even more suitable marriage candidate in mind for you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't trust Rico or his cronies...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't trust Rico or his cronies. I want Vina to be my eyes on the inside."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you want eyes on the inside, se..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want eyes on the inside, send a spy. Don't sacrifice your daughter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina folded her arms defiantly."
entries.dialogueText: Vina folded her arms defiantly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Marry Rico, and nobody will challe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Marry Rico, and nobody will challenge your position as Queen of Rizia. The reforms we've been planning will only be the beginning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Imagine what the throne could do i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine what the throne could do if we channeled the full power of Su Omina. Nobody would dare stand in our way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are at war. Every action we tak..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are at war. Every action we take as the Royal Family, no matter how personal, must be done with the kingdom's stability in mind."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""How will a union borne of mutual r..."
entries.dialogueText: "How will a union borne of mutual resentment lead to stability?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Think about it. As Prince Consort,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. As Prince Consort, that idiot will be completely under our thumb. He won't be able to do any more damage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus himself will agree that main..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus himself will agree that maintaining peace and order in Rizia is more important than your little love affair."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What about Uncle Hugo? I doubt he'..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about Uncle Hugo? I doubt he'll sit by and let it happen."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you think that's what I want, y..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think that's what I want, you're madder than he is."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""He shouldn't be under our thumb. H..."
entries.dialogueText: "He shouldn't be under our thumb. He should be in prison."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Marry Rico, and nobody will challe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Marry Rico, and nobody will challenge your position as Queen of Rizia. You'll be able to make as many radical decrees as you want."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Are you sure of that? Perhaps I sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure of that? Perhaps I should ask him."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But my heart belongs to Manus.""
entries.dialogueText: "But my heart belongs to Manus."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I am not in love with him.""
entries.dialogueText: "But I am not in love with him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Feelings do not factor into this e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Feelings do not factor into this equation. You have a chance to make history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will grow to love him over tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will grow to love him over time. It happened with me and your mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon will understand that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon will understand that the historic reunification of Rizia and Pales takes precedence over your little affair."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will grow to love him over tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will grow to love him over time. I am sure of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need to tell you how impor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need to tell you how important alliances between monarchies are, Vina. You yourself are the product of one."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""As you loved Mother?""
entries.dialogueText: "As you loved Mother?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her voice dripped with sarcasm. Est..."
entries.dialogueText: Her voice dripped with sarcasm. Estela clicked her tongue.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You'd never been in love before. H..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'd never been in love before. How could you even know that was what you felt?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Your great-uncle is in his seventi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your great-uncle is in his seventies, sweetheart. With luck, he'll be long gone by the time you ascend the throne."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Vina, please. Just listen to your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, please. Just listen to your father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you're still hung up on Man..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you're still hung up on Manus. But please try to see the bigger picture."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I see the bigger picture, and it's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see the bigger picture, and it's scaring me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sniffed indignantly."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sniffed indignantly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sniffed indignantly."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sniffed indignantly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Unifying kingdoms through a lovele..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unifying kingdoms through a loveless marriage. Yes, that sounds like history to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is a great burden I am placin..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a great burden I am placing on you, I know. But I wouldn't be asking it of you if I did not think you could bear it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am only asking you to go along w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only asking you to go along with this betrothal for now. We can revisit the situation once peace has been restored."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am only asking you to go along w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only asking you to go along with this betrothal for now. We can revisit the situation once we have a firmer grip on the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall not be so cruel as to forc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall not be so cruel as to force you into an unhappy marriage, Vina. You are free to marry Manus if you wish."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not going to force you to mar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not going to force you to marry your cousin. But I cannot allow you to wed the Sazon heir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is not a request. You will ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not a request. You will marry Ricardus or face the guillotine."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I... I can bear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I can bear it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I... I don't think that I can.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I don't think that I can."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina squeezed her eyes shut and ope..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina squeezed her eyes shut and opened them.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Fine. I agree to marry Ricardus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I agree to marry Ricardus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's back straightened. She spoke..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's back straightened. She spoke with resolve.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm sorry, Father. I can't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Father. I can't."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""My mind is made up. It's Manus or..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mind is made up. It's Manus or no one."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I would rather stay a spinster my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would rather stay a spinster my whole life than marry Rico."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother gripped her silverware so..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother gripped her silverware so hard that her knuckles turned white. Vina's lip trembled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your devotion to the Sazon boy is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your devotion to the Sazon boy is touching. I will grant you permission to wed him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then it is no one. We will put you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then it is no one. We will put your marriage plans on hold for now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry that I led you to belie..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry that I led you to believe you had a choice. You are marrying Ricardus, and that is final."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have made yourself heard. We w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have made yourself heard. We will put your marriage plans on hold for now."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I need a moment. May I please be e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need a moment. May I please be excused from the table?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could answer, she pushed b..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could answer, she pushed back her chair and abruptly stood up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela rose, her eyes full of sorro..."
entries.dialogueText: Estela rose, her eyes full of sorrow.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm going to check in on her. She'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to check in on her. She's liable to throw herself off the balcony otherwise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for an answer, she..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for an answer, she pushed back her chair and stood up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela rose and looked at me approv..."
entries.dialogueText: Estela rose and looked at me approvingly.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Well done, Romus. That can't have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well done, Romus. That can't have been easy."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I should go myself, before my bodi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should go myself, before my bodice takes any more abuse."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina automatically opened her mouth..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina automatically opened her mouth in protest, then registered what I'd said.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you truly mean that, then thank..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly mean that, then thank you. From the bottom of my heart."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I don't know about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know about that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Speaking of falling in love again...."
entries.dialogueText: "Speaking of falling in love again... how open are you to the possibility of another suitor?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have to put your thoughts abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have to put your thoughts about Manus aside because another marriage opportunity has arisen. An important one."

entries.dialogueText: "You know what'll help you get over Manus? A handsome new fiance."

entries.dialogueText: She stared at me disbelievingly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Who?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Ricardus Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Ricardus Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Axel Reinhart.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Axel Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Dinner was tremendous as usual, Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dinner was tremendous as usual, Pabel."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'll pass your compliment on to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll pass your compliment on to the chefs, madam."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel showed my mother out the door..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel showed my mother out the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina let out a frustrated sigh."
entries.dialogueText: Vina let out a frustrated sigh.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I suppose I should be grateful.""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose I should be grateful."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina let out a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: Vina let out a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you for understanding.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for understanding."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She broke into a relieved smile."
entries.dialogueText: She broke into a relieved smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do hope Uncle Hugo won't be too..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope Uncle Hugo won't be too put out."

Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's more than a 'little' affair.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's more than a 'little' affair."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm well aware of that. Although o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm well aware of that. Although our alliance with Rumburg seems to be crumbling despite my existence."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm well aware of that. Aunt Bea n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm well aware of that. Aunt Bea never ceases to remind me of it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""All the more reason for you to mar..."
entries.dialogueText: "All the more reason for you to marry the Duke, sweetheart. Heaven forbid Her Excellency stay cross at us."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""All the more reason for you to mar..."
entries.dialogueText: "All the more reason for you to marry the Duke, sweetheart. Imagine the look on Her Excellency's face."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And do we really want to merge our..."
entries.dialogueText: "And do we really want to merge our house with that of the Reinharts?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But what about the Reinharts? Do w..."
entries.dialogueText: "But what about the Reinharts? Do we really want to merge our house with theirs?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Vina. An arranged marriage can tur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina. An arranged marriage can turn into genuine affection just as easily as so-called true love can curdle into resentment."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I speak, of course, from experienc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I speak, of course, from experience."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I inadvertently glanced at Pabel. H..."
entries.dialogueText: I inadvertently glanced at Pabel. He busied himself polishing some tableware.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That may be so. But what about the..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be so. But what about the Reinharts? Do we really want to merge our house with theirs?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Careful. You're starting to sound..."
entries.dialogueText: "Careful. You're starting to sound like Chancellor Hegel."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""How do you know they'll even be on..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do you know they'll even be on board with our plans for reform?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""They pillaged continents on behalf..."
entries.dialogueText: "They pillaged continents on behalf of the Valgos Empire, then had riches showered on them by the West. Why should they now be rewarded with the hand of a Rizian princess?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I have been privy to your conversa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have been privy to your conversations about them. Will one marriage be enough to resolve centuries of tension?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is not a merger, it's an acqu..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not a merger, it's an acquisition. Reinhart and his family will fall in line if they want Rizia's protection."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reunifying Rizia and Pales will ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reunifying Rizia and Pales will get the rest of the kingdom behind us. They'll have to support whatever we decide."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We can't be certain. But it's a ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't be certain. But it's a risk we must take."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is not as simple as that. Marri..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not as simple as that. Marriage is only the first step in a long process of negotiation and reconciliation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia initiated the aggression aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia initiated the aggression against Pales in the first place. It is up to us to offer a peaceful resolution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They showed generosity in their ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "They showed generosity in their handling of the Aureus gas field affair. I have faith that they will be reliable partners."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I still don't know...""
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't know..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Well, the Chancellor had a point!""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, the Chancellor had a point!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I love Manus because he dared to e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love Manus because he dared to envision a new path for Rizia. A kingdom whose future is determined by all of its citizens, not only those with the most land or titles."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know you have other ideas. But y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you have other ideas. But you allowed us to be together, so you must have been open to compromise."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I thought that's what you wanted,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought that's what you wanted, as well."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A marital alliance with another mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A marital alliance with another monarchy feels like a step backwards to me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""As much as I've enjoyed being on y..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I've enjoyed being on your council, I still believe our kingdom's citizens should have more of a say in its future."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""In the past few years I've dared t..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the past few years I've dared to dream of a new path for Rizia. One where the land is owned and governed by all, not just those with the most titles."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I thought you shared that vision a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you shared that vision as well."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know you don't share that vision..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you don't share that vision. But I always hoped you would come to see it my way."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But a marital alliance with anothe..."
entries.dialogueText: "But a marital alliance with another monarchy... it feels like a step backwards."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What exactly is wrong with a retur..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly is wrong with a return to the glory days of our Golden Kingdom?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know it seems that way. But I as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it seems that way. But I assure you this partnership will benefit everyone in Rizia. Not only nobles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't understand. Reuniting wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't understand. Reuniting with Pales will strengthen us enough to end our dependence on Rumburg and GRACE. An entirely new status quo awaits."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still have every intention of br..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still have every intention of bringing change to Rizia. Our chances of success will be much higher with the wealth and support of Pales behind us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A monarchical system is not 'backw..."
entries.dialogueText: "A monarchical system is not 'backwards' in and of itself. Look at Rumburg and its technological advancements."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not difficult to understand,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not difficult to understand, Vina. Either you stick to your rigid ideals and die a failure, or marry the Duke and gain wealth and power beyond your wildest imagination."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The glory days for whom, Father? W..."
entries.dialogueText: "The glory days for whom, Father? When have ordinary Rizians ever been able to speak up for themselves?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Have you run that plan by Aunt Bea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you run that plan by Aunt Bea yet? I'm sure she has other ideas for the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Technological progress isn't socie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Technological progress isn't societal progress. Rumburg isn't any more enlightened just because Aunt Bea's armies can blow up entire cities in one go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother was smiling proudly."
entries.dialogueText: My mother was smiling proudly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""A life lived according to one's id..."
entries.dialogueText: "A life lived according to one's ideals is not a failure, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If I marry Reinhart, I intend to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I marry Reinhart, I intend to hold you to that promise."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Joining the Royal Council has agre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Joining the Royal Council has agreed with you, hasn't it?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've grown up to become a real s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've grown up to become a real spitfire, haven't you?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I used to be so jealous of noblewo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I used to be so jealous of noblewomen like you. They'd come into my establishment spending like tycoons and talking like encyclopedias."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But when I joined your ranks, I re..."
entries.dialogueText: "But when I joined your ranks, I realized the price of all that privilege. Sooner or later, you've got to put your personal aspirations aside and do your womanly duty on behalf of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not try to talk you into ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not try to talk you into marriage with anyone else. You may determine your own future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there another marriage candidat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there another marriage candidate you have your eye on? Because I'm fresh out of ideas, myself."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""No, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina wiped her eyes with the sleeve..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina wiped her eyes with the sleeve of her dress, ignoring her grandmother's admonishing look.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your grandmother is right. You kne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother is right. You knew all along what would be expected of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come now, Mother. You act as if ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, Mother. You act as if marrying a handsome duke is a punishment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not like that. Marry Axel and..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not like that. Marry Axel and you can pursue whatever dreams you want to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your grandmother is right. It was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother is right. It was never realistic of me to entrust you with choosing your own husband."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, Mother. That's not going to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Mother. That's not going to be Vina's life. My daughter is free to choose her own future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina paused, suddenly uncertain."
entries.dialogueText: Vina paused, suddenly uncertain.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I choose Manus. Thank you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "I choose Manus. Thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a moment, a look of resolve f..."
entries.dialogueText: After a moment, a look of resolve formed on her face.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Marrying Duke Reinhart is what's b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Marrying Duke Reinhart is what's best for Rizia, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have absolutely no doubt that it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have absolutely no doubt that it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never mind the kingdom. I want wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind the kingdom. I want what is best for you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't ask me. Listen to your heart.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't ask me. Listen to your heart."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Then... I will do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then... I will do it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: She took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Then I choose Manus. Thank you, Fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I choose Manus. Thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll do it, Father. I agree to mar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do it, Father. I agree to marry Axel."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'll do it, Father. I agree to wed..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do it, Father. I agree to wed the Duke of Pales."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Then I would rather not wed at all..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I would rather not wed at all. Thank you for understanding."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Then you lied to me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you lied to me."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""That's true. You never lied to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true. You never lied to me about that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Any girl in Rizia would kill to ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any girl in Rizia would kill to have my life. I know."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""All except one.""
entries.dialogueText: "All except one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rubbed her brow, deep in though..."
entries.dialogueText: She rubbed her brow, deep in thought. Finally, she spoke again.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you really believe marrying Axe..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you really believe marrying Axel is what's best for the kingdom.... I will do it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm sorry, Father. It's Manus or n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Father. It's Manus or no one."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm sorry, Father. I'm not going t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Father. I'm not going to marry a man I don't love just to make you happy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't understand, Vina. I am n..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't understand, Vina. I am not giving you a choice. You will marry Axel Reinhart, and Rizia and Pales will be reunited."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tears sprang to Vina's eyes. Her li..."
entries.dialogueText: Tears sprang to Vina's eyes. Her lip trembled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. The strength of your fe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. The strength of your feelings for the Sazon heir has convinced me. I shall sanction your marriage."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina automatically opened her mouth..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina automatically opened her mouth in protest, then registered what I said.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But that's wonderful. Thank you, F..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that's wonderful. Thank you, Father!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do hope Axel won't be too put ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope Axel won't be too put out. "

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I do hope Duke Reinhart won't be t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope Duke Reinhart won't be too put out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then you will marry no one.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you will marry no one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that's truly how you feel, then..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's truly how you feel, then we will put your marriage plans on hold."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Tears sprang to her eyes. She nodde..."
entries.dialogueText: Tears sprang to her eyes. She nodded gratefully.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you for understanding.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for understanding."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sighed in frustration."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sighed in frustration.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I suppose I should be grateful. So..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose I should be grateful. So thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I... I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I understand."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""May I please be excused? I need a..."
entries.dialogueText: "May I please be excused? I need a moment."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I just need to figure out what to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just need to figure out what to say to Manus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He will. But that's my problem to..."
entries.dialogueText: "He will. But that's my problem to deal with, not yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He'll find someone else to marry...."
entries.dialogueText: "He'll find someone else to marry. He's incredibly good-looking, you know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We still have our energy partnersh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have our energy partnership. This marriage would have been a mere bonus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is not a step backwards. It is..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not a step backwards. It is all part of God's plan for Rizia and this family."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'd like to have a word with God a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to have a word with God about His plans, and why women's autonomy so rarely factors into them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: She took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela rose, her eyes full of sorro..."
entries.dialogueText: Estela rose, her eyes full of sorrow.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It pains me to see her so miserabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "It pains me to see her so miserable, Romus. Even if our kingdom will be better for it in the long run."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not as put out as Queen Beatrice w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not as put out as Queen Beatrice when she realizes we won't be bringing Pales into the fold."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""In the short run, I'm going to go..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the short run, I'm going to go check up on the poor dear."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm sure he'll understand. You can..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure he'll understand. You can always keep seeing him on the side, after all."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, marvelous!""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, marvelous!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you do, use caution. I want you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you do, use caution. I want your children to have that Reinhart jaw."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Affairs are the backbone of any ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Affairs are the backbone of any royal marriage. Just keep them hush-hush."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother clapped her hands."
entries.dialogueText: My mother clapped her hands.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Pabel, some champagne? We've got a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel, some champagne? We've got an engagement to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Give the Duke a chance first. He c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give the Duke a chance first. He could surprise you, after all."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Right away, madam.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, madam."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Allow me to saber it. There must b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Allow me to saber it. There must be a sword around this room somewhere..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, we're getting ahead of ourselv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, we're getting ahead of ourselves. Pabel, some champagne? We've got a royal engagement to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He absconded to the kitchen and ret..."
entries.dialogueText: He absconded to the kitchen and returned with a bottle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pour yourself a glass, Pabel. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pour yourself a glass, Pabel. It's a special occasion!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall abstain. Why don't you pou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall abstain. Why don't you pour yourself a glass, Pabel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just sparkling water for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just sparkling water for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure, I'll take a glass. It's a sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, I'll take a glass. It's a special occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From a more auspicious year, I hop..."
entries.dialogueText: "From a more auspicious year, I hope."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel briskly shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel briskly shook his head.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It's a very expensive vintage. Not..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a very expensive vintage. Not to be wasted on butlers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel nodded and filled our glasses..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel nodded and filled our glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel smiled.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Yes, why not? I daresay I've been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, why not? I daresay I've been in a celebratory mood myself lately."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I've taken the liberty of opening..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've taken the liberty of opening it already, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""1948. The date of your first conta..."
entries.dialogueText: "1948. The date of your first contact with Duke Reinhart, I believe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He filled our glasses, and Vina hoi..."
entries.dialogueText: He filled our glasses, and Vina hoisted hers high. The hint of a smile was beginning to show on her face.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""To a reunited Rizia. Perhaps this..."
entries.dialogueText: "To a reunited Rizia. Perhaps this will be fun after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hear, hear!""
entries.dialogueText: "Hear, hear!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia axa Pales!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia axa Pales!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To a reunited Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "To a reunited Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To Vina and Axel!""
entries.dialogueText: "To Vina and Axel!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We clinked our glasses."
entries.dialogueText: We clinked our glasses.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Over dessert, we began discussing t..."
entries.dialogueText: Over dessert, we began discussing the wedding preparations.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That was uncalled for, Romus. Give..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was uncalled for, Romus. Given more time, she might have been open to persuasion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put down her fork and looked at..."
entries.dialogueText: She put down her fork and looked at me.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""When I went to Pales, I felt as if..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I went to Pales, I felt as if I had a real purpose."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've done nothing but perform supe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've done nothing but perform superficial princess duties since we moved to Porte Drazon."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""For a time, my conversations with..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a time, my conversations with Manus were the only thing sustaining me. Now..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned forward and looked me in..."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned forward and looked me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Between my time on the royal counc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between my time on the royal council and my trip to Pales, I've had a taste of what leadership is like."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""My time on the council has taught..."
entries.dialogueText: "My time on the council has taught me so much these past years. I've had a taste of what leadership is like."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Before that, my conversations with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before that, my conversations with Manus were the only thing sustaining me. Now..."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father... I confess I have been fe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father... I confess I have been feeling rather aimless lately."

entries.dialogueText: "It sounds like you're ready for a new role. That of wife."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "No time for existential crises, Vina. Duke Axel Reinhart has requested your hand in marriage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "What? Wed to whom?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Axel Reinhart.""
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Axel Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your cousin Ricardus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your cousin Ricardus."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What? Is there a specific husband..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? Is there a specific husband you have in mind for me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please tell me more.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please tell me more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you know how privileged you are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you know how privileged you are? Any girl in Rizia would kill to be you, and you're feeling 'aimless'?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hesitated."
entries.dialogueText: She hesitated.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I know. But I can't help it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. But I can't help it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The road to the throne is paved wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The road to the throne is paved with incestuous pairings, dear."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Or it used to be.""

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: My mother smiled broadly.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A Rizian princess, marrying her tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "A Rizian princess, marrying her true love. Your grandfather would be proud."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I confess I'm not thrilled about i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess I'm not thrilled about it. But at least he isn't a commoner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If this doesn't earn us House Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this doesn't earn us House Sazon's support in the war, nothing will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Her true love and the majority spe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her true love and the majority speaker in the House of Delegates. This will be unbelievably advantageous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If this doesn't earn us House Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this doesn't earn us House Sazon's support, nothing will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina should be able to marry the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina should be able to marry the person she loves. Everyone in Rizia deserves that right."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And they have it, thanks to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "And they have it, thanks to you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""*Everyone*?""
entries.dialogueText: "*Everyone*?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Careful whom you offend, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Careful whom you offend, Romus."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And the way the boy was carrying o..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the way the boy was carrying on before the war, he might as well be a commoner."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela

entries.dialogueText: "And the way the boy's been carrying on, he might as well be a commoner."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Assuming the boy makes it home ali..."
entries.dialogueText: "Assuming the boy makes it home alive, you mean."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You've already got the house eatin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've already got the house eating out of the palm of your hand. Or maybe it's the other way around."
