entries.title: Narrator: "She briefly glanced in the directio..."
entries.dialogueText: She briefly glanced in the direction of the kitchen.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A real feather in the cap for Romu..."
entries.dialogueText: "A real feather in the cap for Romus the Reformer."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You could use the help, it's true.""
entries.dialogueText: "You could use the help, it's true."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's right. He threatens the mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right. He threatens the monarchy, Vina threatens to shut her legs for a week."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Grandmother!""
entries.dialogueText: "Grandmother!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Realization sparked in her eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Realization sparked in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What? Sex is as good a weapon as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? Sex is as good a weapon as any to keep the Sazons in line."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina almost choked on her food."
entries.dialogueText: Vina almost choked on her food.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She scooped the last bit of rice of..."
entries.dialogueText: She scooped the last bit of rice off her plate.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Manus and I have already started l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus and I have already started looking for a suitable residence in the capital."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, he will be. But that's my prob..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, he will be. But that's my problem to deal with, not yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The old man will be dead in a few..."
entries.dialogueText: "The old man will be dead in a few years anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Disappointing one's relatives is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Disappointing one's relatives is all part of being a royal. He will get over it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Frankly, I'm more worried what Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, I'm more worried what Rico will get up to without a wife to tie him down."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He filled our glasses, and Vina hoi..."
entries.dialogueText: He filled our glasses, and Vina hoisted hers high.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""1951. The date of your first royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "1951. The date of your first royal visit to the Sazons in Sallabes."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""To Houses Toras and Sazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "To Houses Toras and Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And Azaro, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "And Azaro, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To true love.""
entries.dialogueText: "To true love."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the new faces of Rizian royalty.""
entries.dialogueText: "To the new faces of Rizian royalty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother had a frown on her face."
entries.dialogueText: My mother had a frown on her face.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""This was a grand opportunity, my g..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was a grand opportunity, my girl. I hope you won't come to regret rejecting it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But we're getting ahead of ourselv..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we're getting ahead of ourselves. Pabel, some champagne? We have an engagement to celebrate."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I need a moment. May I be excused?""
entries.dialogueText: "I need a moment. May I be excused?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for an answer, she..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for an answer, she elegantly exited the dining room, brushing past Pabel on her way out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Estela stood as well, her eyes full..."
entries.dialogueText: Estela stood as well, her eyes full of sympathy.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You can't keep the girl in a cage..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't keep the girl in a cage forever, Romus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rose and pushed in her chair."
entries.dialogueText: She rose and pushed in her chair.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This has all been rather overwhelm..."
entries.dialogueText: "This has all been rather overwhelming. May I please be excused?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without waiting for an answer, she..."
entries.dialogueText: Without waiting for an answer, she elegantly exited the dining room, brushing past Pabel on her way out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother looked bemused as she wat..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother looked bemused as she watched Vina leave.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""One moment she's ready to accuse y..."
entries.dialogueText: "One moment she's ready to accuse you of murder, the next she's taking her rightful place as a Toras."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's far more useful knowledge t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's far more useful knowledge than anything you could learn on a council."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From me, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "From me, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Her mother always had a keen mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Her mother always had a keen mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm suspicious of her motives. Do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm suspicious of her motives. Do you think she's plotting against me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, the tempestuousness of youth.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, the tempestuousness of youth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's best to keep her occupied. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's best to keep her occupied. Who knows what she could get up to if she isn't?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Where does she get it from? The on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where does she get it from? The only politics I was interested in at her age was which of your father's friends was sleeping with which actresses."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Superficial gossip is what being a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Superficial gossip is what being a Duchess is all about, isn't it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's not interested in politics...."
entries.dialogueText: "She's not interested in politics. She just wants to galivant around till she forgets her troubles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's wrong about my involvement,..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's wrong about my involvement, by the way. In case you had any doubt."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised an eyebrow cryptically."
entries.dialogueText: She raised an eyebrow cryptically.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I have no doubt at all.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have no doubt at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised an eyebrow cryptically."
entries.dialogueText: She raised an eyebrow cryptically.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You're right about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right about that."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's every girl's dream to turn in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's every girl's dream to turn into her father."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You'd better believe it.""
entries.dialogueText: "You'd better believe it."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Keep an eye on her, Romus. That's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep an eye on her, Romus. That's all I'll say."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""She still looks up to you. That's..."
entries.dialogueText: "She still looks up to you. That's rare at her age."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'll go check in on her.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll go check in on her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He came over to clear my plate, avo..."
entries.dialogueText: He came over to clear my plate, avoiding eye contact with me as he did so.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made the right choice. Didn't I?""
entries.dialogueText: "I made the right choice. Didn't I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sit down. Have a drink with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sit down. Have a drink with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're judging me. You will stop i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're judging me. You will stop it at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't say anything to him."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything to him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head stiffly."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head stiffly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Thank you, but I can't. We've hire..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, but I can't. We've hired a new dishwasher and she's still leaving streaks on the silver."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shook his head sadly."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Congratulations, Your Majesty. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations, Your Majesty. You've made Rizia a more free place for everyone but your own daughter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel nodded quickly."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel nodded quickly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Absolutely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took my plate and walked away."
entries.dialogueText: He took my plate and walked away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel shook his head sadly."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I see how it is now. If His Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see how it is now. If His Majesty can't be happy, nobody can. Including his own daughter."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I would never judge you, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never judge you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""As for the future of House Toras...""
entries.dialogueText: "As for the future of House Toras..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You should strongly consider a bac..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should strongly consider a back-up plan."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It will have to remain unwritten f..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will have to remain unwritten for now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked uneasily towards the kit..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked uneasily towards the kitchen.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I trust you will put family first.""
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you will put family first."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We finished our dinner and headed t..."
entries.dialogueText: We finished our dinner and headed to our separate quarters.

entries.dialogueText: Tears came to Vina's eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We have to look at the Sazons as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have to look at the Sazons as allies, not enemies."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Really, Father? That would mean th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really, Father? That would mean the world to Manus."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What happened to Father was ghastl..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happened to Father was ghastly. But she had no part in it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You should hear her plans for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should hear her plans for the city. It will be as if Rico was never there."

entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Though eventually I hope to begin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though eventually I hope to begin splitting my time between here and Monqiz, if I am to take up the mantle of Duchess."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't get too greedy, young lady...."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get too greedy, young lady. You're only 23."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We'll see how much time you have for the council once the babies start coming, sweetheart."

entries.dialogueText: "The very same royal council that you and Mr. Sazon plan to do away with?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You'll need my help if you want to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll need my help if you want to persuade the others of the need for reform. Especially Uncle Hugo."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "How unfair. Would you say that to a man?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's favoritism, love. My counci..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's favoritism, love. My councilors all earned their positions by merit."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh, Father. You know that's not tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Father. You know that's not true."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're getting ahead of yourself,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're getting ahead of yourself, young lady. You're only 23."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "You were about the same age when you became Duke."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can think of no better candidate..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can think of no better candidate for the position."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A mere ceremonial title, if you an..."
entries.dialogueText: "A mere ceremonial title, if you and Mr. Sazon have your way."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But still an important one. Especi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But still an important one. Especially if we are to keep the members of House Toras on our side."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Of course you can't. It's the role..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course you can't. It's the role I was literally born to play."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A lovely idea. But a man and wife..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lovely idea. But a man and wife shouldn't live separately. Too much potential for temptation."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""For some people, maybe.""
entries.dialogueText: "For some people, maybe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother gave her a wry smile."
entries.dialogueText: My mother gave her a wry smile.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""We'll see how much time you have f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll see how much time you have for commuting once the babies start coming, sweetheart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina has juggled multiple obligati..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina has juggled multiple obligations throughout her life. I am confident she can balance motherhood and a royal career."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Precisely. Who says Vina even need..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. Who says Vina even needs to have children?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry about it, Vina. Your n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about it, Vina. Your nannies and housekeepers will do most of the work, anyway."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Don't be naive, Romus. Producing a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be naive, Romus. Producing a successor is non-negotiable."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""So am I.""
entries.dialogueText: "So am I."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I-- that isn't what I meant. But c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I-- that isn't what I meant. But children are years in the future, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your grandmother's right. Raising..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your grandmother's right. Raising children is the most sacred duty you can perform for your kingdom."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's important. But it is only one..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's important. But it is only one duty among many."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Your great-grandmother changed man..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your great-grandmother changed many rules for woman in Rizia. The expectations for wives and mothers were not among them."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I would ask for one thing in retur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would ask for one thing in return, though."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned forward to look me in th..."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned forward to look me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Send me to Monqiz. I'm finally rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Send me to Monqiz. I'm finally ready to take up the mantle of Duchess of Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're getting ahead of yourself,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're getting ahead of yourself, young lady. You're only 23."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can think of no better candidate..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can think of no better candidate for the position."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes. Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Exactly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A largely ceremonial position, if..."
entries.dialogueText: "A largely ceremonial position, if you had your way."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But still an important one.""
entries.dialogueText: "But still an important one."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A long-distance marriage will be f..."
entries.dialogueText: "A long-distance marriage will be frowned upon by traditionalists. But if this is what she wants, it's the least you can do."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: My mother gave me a wry smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Of course you can't. It's the role..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course you can't. It's the role I was literally born to play."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But Rico needs to stay in Iza. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Rico needs to stay in Iza. You wouldn't be living together."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rose and pushed in her chair."
entries.dialogueText: She rose and pushed in her chair.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This is all rather overwhelming. M..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is all rather overwhelming. May I please be excused?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, all right. From now on, Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, all right. From now on, Vina Toras will be Duchess of Valenqiris as well as the fiancee of Duke Ricardus Toras of Iza."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She thought it over for a moment, t..."
entries.dialogueText: She thought it over for a moment, then nodded.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

Princess Vina

entries.dialogueText: "I want you to send me to Monqiz. Allow me to take the mantle of Duchess of Valenqiris."

entries.dialogueText: "If the system isn't going to change, I can at least try to make people's lives better within it."

entries.dialogueText: "A mostly ceremonial role."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But still an important one.""
entries.dialogueText: "But still an important one."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You and your father both used Vale..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and your father both used Valenqiris as a training ground for becoming king. There's no reason Vina shouldn't do the same."

entries.dialogueText: "Of course you can't. It's the role I was literally born to play."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thought you had misgivings about..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you had misgivings about the monarchy. Now you want to become a Duchess?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She broke into a wide smile."
entries.dialogueText: She broke into a wide smile.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, all right. From now on, Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, all right. From now on, Vina Toras will be Duchess of Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. My mind is made up. Vina will..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. My mind is made up. Vina will stay in Porte Drazon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She eyed me closely."
entries.dialogueText: She eyed me closely.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""For some, yes. But for your daught..."
entries.dialogueText: "For some, yes. But for your daughter..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face fell."
entries.dialogueText: Her face fell.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Under the circumstances.""
entries.dialogueText: "Under the circumstances."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. I still have your mother's r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. I still have your mother's ring. I want you to wear it at the wedding."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina scrunched up her face."
entries.dialogueText: Vina scrunched up her face.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Just like I always dreamed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just like I always dreamed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She elegantly exited the dining roo..."
entries.dialogueText: She elegantly exited the dining room, brushing past Pabel on her way out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's not so bad. You might learn t..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's not so bad. You might learn to love him.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Ha. Right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. Right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's for the good of the kingdom...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's for the good of the kingdom. You'll thank me someday."

entries.dialogueText: "It's for the good of the kingdom. You'll thank me someday."

entries.dialogueText: She looked like she was about to be sick. Without replying to me, she fled the dining room, nearly knocking over Pabel on the way out.

entries.dialogueText: Before I could answer, she pushed back her chair and abruptly stood up.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Oh, Father. It would be an honor.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, Father. It would be an honor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never mind. You're obviously not r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. You're obviously not ready yet."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother flashed me a grateful gla..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother flashed me a grateful glance.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's best to keep yourself busy. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's best to keep yourself busy. You'll forget about him before you know it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a shame. You're one of my mos..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a shame. You're one of my most valuable councilors."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I can't gain the experience I..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I can't gain the experience I need unless I strike out on my own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's your choice, Vina. It always..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's your choice, Vina. It always has been."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The son of my kidnapper wouldn't b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The son of my kidnapper wouldn't be my first choice, of course. But your happiness comes above all else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Honestly, if you didn't choose him..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, if you didn't choose him as a suitor, I would have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina Reinhart, Queen of Rizia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina Reinhart, Queen of Rizia and Grand Duchess of Pales. Doesn't that have a nice ring to it?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I can't bear it anymore. Father, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't bear it anymore. Father, why did you do it?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And I think I'm ready for more.""
entries.dialogueText: "And I think I'm ready for more."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you're serious about reforming..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're serious about reforming Rizia, you'll need help on the inside."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Please, Father. It's the only thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Father. It's the only thing that will get my mind off of Manus."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Please, Father. If I can't be with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Father. If I can't be with the person I love, at least grant me this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother let out a loud laugh, the..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother let out a loud laugh, then clapped a hand over her mouth.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Queen Lyza was making laws at age..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Lyza was making laws at age 23. So was Aunt Bea."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Honestly, Father, just because you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, Father, just because you spent your twenties in a drunken stupor doesn't mean everyone should--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forget it, Vina. You'll neither ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forget it, Vina. You'll neither marry Ricardus nor become Duchess. You'll stay right here in Porte Drazon until we find you another marriage candidate."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""There are other noblewomen out the..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are other noblewomen out there for Ricardus. Men like him always fall upwards."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina was only half-listening to us."
entries.dialogueText: Vina was only half-listening to us.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Now that the marriage has been set..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that the marriage has been settled on, we'd better start looking for a residence in the capital."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Never. My future is with Manus. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never. My future is with Manus. I know it."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""In fact, now that the marriage has..."
entries.dialogueText: "In fact, now that the marriage has been decided on, we'd better start looking for a residence in the capital."
